data.name: CommandLineHelp
data.value:
Gurux DLMS sample reads data from a DLMS/COSEM device. Usage: Gurux.DLMS.Client.Example.Net -h HOST -p PORT [options] Gurux.DLMS.Client.Example.Net -S PORT[:BAUD:FRAMING] [options]
--help, -? Show this help. -h HOST Host name or IP address. -p PORT TCP/UDP port, 1–65535. -u Use UDP (CoAP selects UDP automatically). -S PORT Serial port, for example COM1 or COM1:9600:8None1. -i TYPE Interface type, for example HDLC, WRAPPER or HdlcWithModeE. -r sn|ln Referencing mode (default: ln). -c ADDRESS Client address (default: 16; HDLC 1–127, WRAPPER 1–65535). -s ADDRESS Server address (default: 1). -l ADDRESS Logical server address, 0–16383. -n NUMBER Derive server address from the meter serial number. -a TYPE Authentication: None, Low, High, HighMD5, HighSHA1, HighGMAC, HighSHA256 or HighECDSA. -P PASSWORD Authentication password; prefix hexadecimal bytes with 0x. -C LEVEL Security: None, Authentication, Encryption or AuthenticationEncryption. -V SUITE Security suite: Suite0, Suite1 or Suite2 (default: Suite0). -K SIGNING Signing scheme, for example None or GeneralSigning. -T HEX Client system title (8 bytes). -M HEX Meter system title (8 bytes). -A HEX Authentication key (16 bytes; Suite2: 32 bytes). -B HEX Block cipher key (16 bytes; Suite2: 32 bytes). -b HEX Broadcast block cipher key (16 bytes; Suite2: 32 bytes). -D HEX Dedicated key (16 bytes; Suite2: 32 bytes). -F COUNTER Initial invocation counter, 0–4294967295. -v LN Invocation-counter object, for example 0.0.43.1.0.255. -I Automatically increase the invoke ID. -g OBJECTS Read selected attributes, for example "0.0.1.0.0.255:2;1.0.1.8.0.255:2". -o PATH XML association cache and output file. -d STANDARD DLMS standard, for example DLMS, India, Italy, SaudiArabia or IDIS. -E LN Export certificates from the security setup object. -N LN Generate and import certificates for the security setup object. -G ID:ADDR Gateway network ID and physical address, for example 0:1 or 0:0x1234. -m ADDRESS PLC MAC destination address, 0–65535. -W SIZE General Block Transfer window, 1–63. -w SIZE HDLC window, 1–7 (default: 1). -f SIZE HDLC frame size, 32–2030 (default: 128). -x MS Response/open timeout, positive milliseconds (default: 5000). -z MS Delay after opening the transport, nonnegative milliseconds (default: 1000). -t LEVEL Trace level: Off, Error, Warning, Info or Verbose (default: Info). -O FLAGS Proposed conformance, for example "Get,Set". -L ID Manufacturer ID, for example LGZ. -R TYPE Broadcast service: UnConfirmed or Confirmed.
Examples: -h localhost -p 4063 -i WRAPPER -c 1 -a Low -P Gurux -S COM1:9600:8None1 -c 16 -s 1 -a Low -P password -h localhost -p 4063 -i WRAPPER -z 0
Press Ctrl+C to cancel and close the connection.
